_comment: OFFLINE validation of the captured Trivy inputs (task #5). Image pinned by digest to commit 30e4c44 (rescan-30e4c44). Pulls the release results and the captured module cache + checks bundle WITHOUT a proxy, then blocks TRIVY's network by pointing the UPPERCASE HTTPS_PROXY/HTTP_PROXY at a dead local port (Go + git honor these). The lowercase https_proxy is deliberately NOT set: Checkov reads only that spelling, and blocking it stops Checkov fetching its vendor 'public run config', which changes which Checkov checks fire (rev 1 did this and produced spurious extra CKV findings). Checkov therefore keeps network access, as in the recorded run; aws s3 calls run outside the proxy scope. A negative control first proves the block works (empty cache must lose AWS-0028 on module_0045_claude-sonnet-5) and aborts (exit 3) otherwise. Then restores the captured bundle (VARIANT=full, or VARIANT=nogit with .git dirs stripped) and rescans only the remote-module inputs/games with TRIVY_SKIP_CHECK_UPDATE=true. On a nogit pass it also uploads the stripped archive. Writes only to OUT_S3_URI.

containerDefinitions.name: rescan
command: set -u; B='env HTTPS_PROXY=http://127.0.0.1:9 HTTP_PROXY=http://127.0.0.1:9 TRIVY_SKIP_CHECK_UPDATE=true'; echo "[offline] start $(date -u +%FT%TZ) variant=$VARIANT commit=$TERRAREPAIR_GIT_COMMIT out=$OUT_S3_URI"; aws s3 sync "$RESULTS_S3_URI" /app/rel --exclude '_smoke/*' --only-show-errors || { echo '[offline] FATAL: pull results'; exit 2; }; mkdir -p /app/b /app/out; aws s3 cp "$BUNDLE_S3_URI/trivy_module_cache.tar.gz" /app/b/ --only-show-errors && aws s3 cp "$BUNDLE_S3_URI/trivy_checks_bundle.tar.gz" /app/b/ --only-show-errors || { echo '[offline] FATAL: pull bundles'; exit 2; }; echo "[offline] pulled $(ls /app/rel/games/*.json | wc -l) games, bundles: $(du -sh /app/b | cut -f1)"; NC=$(mktemp -d); NT=$(mktemp -d); cp /app/rel/games/module_0045_claude-sonnet-5.repaired.tf $NC/main.tf; $B TMPDIR=$NT trivy config --format json --quiet --timeout 900s $NC > /app/out/negative_control.json 2>/app/out/negative_control.stderr; echo "[offline] negative control rc=$? cache_entries=$(ls $NT/.aqua/cache 2>/dev/null | wc -l)"; if grep -q AWS-0028 /app/out/negative_control.json; then echo '[offline] FATAL: network NOT blocked (empty cache still produced AWS-0028)'; aws s3 sync /app/out "$OUT_S3_URI" --only-show-errors; exit 3; fi; echo '[offline] negative control OK: blocked scan with empty cache lost AWS-0028'; mkdir -p /root/.cache; rm -rf /root/.cache/trivy/policy /tmp/.aqua; tar xzf /app/b/trivy_checks_bundle.tar.gz -C /root/.cache && tar xzf /app/b/trivy_module_cache.tar.gz -C /tmp || { echo '[offline] FATAL: extract'; exit 2; }; rm -f /app/b/trivy_module_cache.tar.gz; if [ "$VARIANT" = nogit ]; then find /tmp/.aqua/cache -name .git -prune -exec rm -rf {} +; fi; echo "[offline] restored cache: $(ls /tmp/.aqua/cache | wc -l) entries, $(du -sh /tmp/.aqua/cache | cut -f1); .git dirs left: $(find /tmp/.aqua/cache -name .git -prune | wc -l); checks: $(cat /root/.cache/trivy/policy/metadata.json)"; ( while true; do sleep "$SYNC_INTERVAL"; aws s3 sync /app/out "$OUT_S3_URI" --exclude '*.tar.gz' --only-show-errors; done ) & SP=$!; $B python3 scripts/rescan_release.py --results /app/rel --out /app/out --only-remote; RC=$?; kill $SP 2>/dev/null; echo "[offline] rescan exit=$RC"; cat /root/.cache/trivy/policy/metadata.json > /app/out/checks_bundle_after.json; if [ "$VARIANT" = nogit ] && [ $RC -eq 0 ]; then tar czf /app/out/trivy_module_cache_nogit.tar.gz -C /tmp .aqua/cache && echo "[offline] stripped archive: $(du -h /app/out/trivy_module_cache_nogit.tar.gz | cut -f1)"; fi; aws s3 sync /app/out "$OUT_S3_URI" --only-show-errors; echo "[offline] end $(date -u +%FT%TZ)"; exit $RC
